command: export RCLONE_CONFIG_SFTP_TYPE=sftp; if [ -n "${CAD_SFTP_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then RCLONE_CONFIG_SFTP_PASS=$(rclone obscure "$CAD_SFTP_PASSWORD"); export RCLONE_CONFIG_SFTP_PASS; fi; exec rclone lsf sftp: --max-depth 1 --contimeout 5s --low-level-retries 1 --retries 1
